case: OTIO via the optional sidecar, rational rates, relative relinking, handles
targets: lib/interchange.mjs timelineModel / verifyModel / relinkCheck / exportOtio / doctor

checks.name: rational rate
checks.expect: all ranges are integer frames with rate 30000/1001; no float seconds; duration_f 135

checks.name: track order and gaps
checks.expect: tracks keep order; a gap is explicit and positive; record_start_f is cumulative

checks.name: relative paths
checks.expect: timelineModel not ok; verifyModel finds no private path in a valid model

checks.name: relink after a move
steps: move the folder to another volume path
checks.expect: every clip resolves and hashes match; a removed file is reported with its path

checks.name: handles
checks.expect: first: state unknown (null, not zero); second: known with a zero head noted; third known

checks.name: sidecar absent
checks.expect: exportOtio ok false, state otio_unavailable, neutral .interchange.json written, NO .otio file; ordinary video production never touches the sidecar

checks.name: sidecar present
checks.setup: Plan 14 only, in the owner's own environment
checks.expect: official library writes and re-reads; compare reports no problems; verified_editor_import false; pin state in_compatible_range_unverified until exact_version is recorded

checks.name: staging name
checks.expect: the part file keeps the .otio extension so the adapter is chosen; it is renamed only after the re-read check
